candidates.source_name: ЕСЈН — Електронски систем за јавни набавки (e-Nabavki) — Public Access portal
candidates.why_relevant: Legally mandated single publication channel for all North Macedonian public procurement: notices (огласи), tender documentation, award/contract notices (известувања за склучен договор), cancellations and realized contracts. Every state-body, municipality, public enterprise and state-owned bank tender for POS terminals, card personalisation, ATM/cash handling, core banking or payment software must appear here. This is the densest primary source for the A2 workstream in MK.

queries_used: North Macedonia acquirer POS terminals partnership Visa Mastercard CaSys KIBS tender procurement

candidates.source_name: Licentium — North Macedonia licensing hub (commercial advisory)
candidates.why_relevant: Advisory-firm summaries of the MK PI/EMI regime (capital, fees, NBRNM process) give a fast English orientation and, importantly, indicate advisory demand — a proxy for how many applicants are in the pipeline. Commercially motivated, so verify against NBRSM.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Occasional capture; always cross-check facts against NBRSM primary sources
queries_used: payment institution electronic money institution register National Bank North Macedonia

negative_findings.description: A plain HTTPS fetch of https://e-nabavki.gov.mk/ returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: No content retrieved from the ESJN root by a simple fetcher. The portal is linked as the live ESJN entry point from bjn.gov.mk and appears in many current search results, so the most likely explanation is bot/WAF defence or a strict user-agent check rather than an outage. Recorded as unverified, NOT as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important source in this cell cannot be collected with a naive HTTP client. The collector must be designed around a browser-like session from the start (cookies, __VIEWSTATE/__EVENTVALIDATION, realistic headers), and liveness must be re-tested by the deterministic verification pass.

negative_findings.description: Fetch of https://dkzjn.gov.mk/ returned essentially only the acronym 'ДКЖЈН' with no navigable structure.
negative_findings.result_summary: Could not enumerate the appeals-decision database or confirm whether decisions are individually addressable URLs. Annual report PDFs under dkzjn.gov.mk/sites/default/files/zalbi/ do surface in search results, indicating the domain is live and serves static files.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Appeal decisions are the richest disclosure of bidder identities and evaluation reasoning for contested payments tenders; if the decision search is JS-only, collection needs a headless browser and the effort estimate rises.

negative_findings.description: Neither the Macedonian nor the English searches surfaced any concrete, individually identifiable banking/payments tender or award notice (e.g. a specific POS-terminal or card-services contract) for North Macedonia.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search engines index the ESJN portal shell and institutional landing pages but not the individual notice records, which live behind the portal's dynamic grids. No specific лот for POS terminals, платежни картички or банкарски услуги could be cited.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that discovery-by-web-search is structurally insufficient for this cell: notice-level intelligence is only obtainable by querying the ESJN portal itself (or its open-data export). It also means no sample notice was available to reverse-engineer the record schema during this pass.

negative_findings.description: The ESJN 'Отворени податоци' machine-readable export is described in secondary sources but its concrete download/API URL was not found.
negative_findings.result_summary: BJN/ESJN communications state that concluded-contract data is downloadable in a processable format with one click and that data.gov.mk carries a redirect link, but no direct endpoint URL appeared in search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This endpoint, if it exists as described, would be the cheapest and most reliable collection path and would eliminate the 403/scraping problem entirely. Locating it should be the first task of the next pass.

negative_findings.description: The acronym 'ЕСЈН / ESJN' is used interchangeably with the brand 'е-Набавки / e-Nabavki' and one English search engine result questioned whether ESJN exists as a portal.
negative_findings.result_summary: BJN's own site resolves the ambiguity: ЕСЈН (Електронски систем за јавни набавки) is the system, e-nabavki.gov.mk is its address, and e-Пазар is a sub-module for small-value procurement.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query construction and de-duplication must treat ЕСЈН, ESJN, е-набавки, e-Nabavki and eNabavki as aliases of one source, or the register will fragment into duplicate entries.

negative_findings.description: English-language searching for a Ministry of Finance / state tender specifically for payment-card acquiring or card-issuing services returned no concrete notice or award.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only generic framework descriptions of the MK procurement system surfaced; no institution-level award notice for card acquiring was located via open web search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that such notices are effectively only discoverable inside ESJN or on institution sites in Macedonian — English search is structurally insufficient for this cell.

negative_findings.description: The seed reference 'fiom.com.mk' for the Pension and Disability Insurance Fund did not resolve to any procurement source in search.
negative_findings.result_summary: The Fund's material is published under piom.com.mk; searches on the fiom domain returned nothing relevant.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream collection configured against fiom.com.mk would silently collect nothing; the actor registry must record ПИОМ/ФПИОСМ → piom.com.mk.

negative_findings.description: Direct HTTP fetches of finance.gov.mk (ECONNREFUSED) and fzo.org.mk (403) failed from this environment.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both hosts are strongly represented in the search index, so these are treated as bot/geo defences, not dead sites; recorded as unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for the two most important buyers in this cell will need a headless browser with MK locale/UA rather than a plain HTTP client.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated 'јавни набавки' landing page was located on ujp.gov.mk or piom.com.mk through search.
negative_findings.result_summary: UJP procurement material surfaced only as a document-category page and a loose PDF; PIOM only via board decisions and annual accounts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For these two authorities ESJN plus FOI, rather than site scraping, is likely the primary collection route — an important design input.

negative_findings.description: No standalone Treasury (Трезор) procurement page or separate Treasury contracting authority was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: The Treasury is an internal MoF sector; its purchases appear under the Ministry of Finance as the contracting authority.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief lists 'Treasury' as a distinct authority; collection should treat it as an MoF sub-unit, not a separate publisher.

negative_findings.description: The MBA members page URL (https://mba.mk/w/mk/za-nas/clenovi/) was identified from site navigation, but the enumerated member roster itself was not read; the About page only states membership comprises the banks and savings houses plus KIBS and the Macedonian Credit Bureau.
negative_findings.result_summary: Members page exists and is linked, roster content unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The actor list must be extracted from the page itself before it can seed downstream scouts; count of 14 banks is reported second-hand.

negative_findings.description: No standalone public 'register of qualified suppliers/economic operators' portal separate from ESJN was found for North Macedonia; economic-operator registration appears to exist only as an account/registration function inside ESJN, and the closest public list is the negative-references (exclusion) record.
negative_findings.result_summary: Supplier enumeration must be derived from award/contract data and negative references rather than a published whitelist.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Changes the collection strategy for the supplier long tail: derive, do not download.

negative_findings.description: All attempted fetches of nbrm.mk pages returned HTTP 403 to a plain fetch, while the same pages are indexed by search engines.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bot defence hypothesis, not a dead site; requires browser-like collection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: NBRSM holds the authoritative licensee registers; a naive crawler would wrongly mark them dead.

negative_findings.description: The public-procurement appeals commission appears under at least three hosts: dkzjn.gov.mk, dkzjn.mk, and dkzjn.sorsix.com. Which is canonical/current was not determined.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three candidate hosts, canonical one unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection configured against a deprecated host would silently miss decisions.

negative_findings.description: Central Registry terms of use explicitly forbid reproduction, distribution or commercial exploitation of its data without prior consent.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bulk scraping of crm.com.mk is not permissible; licensed distribution service exists instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines whether the entity-resolution backbone can be automated or must be licensed.

negative_findings.description: For the Macedonian e-Commerce Association (ecommerce.mk) no member-company directory page was located; only about/content pages were found.
negative_findings.result_summary: PSP/merchant enumeration from this association is not currently possible without direct contact.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leaves a gap in the payments-acceptance actor map (acquirers, PSPs, gateways).

negative_findings.description: No Macedonian-language equivalent of a 'debarment list' beyond 'негативни референци' was found; there is no separate MK term or register for corporate blacklisting outside the procurement law's negative-reference mechanism.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only 'негативни референци' is the operative local term.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents wasted query expansion on non-existent register types.

negative_findings.description: No publicly indexed ДКЖЈН decision was found that concerns a banking, card-processing or payment-services tender specifically. Searches combining the commission with 'банка' returned only institutional documents, not case texts.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank/payments-specific appeal decisions could not be located through search-engine indexing; they may exist but be reachable only through the commission's own (JS-rendered or application-based) case search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's core promise — appeals exposing bid contents and prices for banking/payments contracts — is unproven until the ДКЖЈН decision register itself is opened and queried by CPV/subject. This should be the first task of the collection phase, not an assumption.

negative_findings.description: Direct fetch of https://dzr.mk/mk/revizorski-izvestai returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, and https://dkzjn.gov.mk/ returned essentially empty content (only the acronym).
negative_findings.result_summary: Both are hypotheses about access mechanics, not evidence the sources are dead — dzr.mk pages are freshly indexed by search engines and dkzjn.gov.mk serves PDFs from its file tree.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive verification pass could wrongly mark the two most important sources in this cell as dead. Both need a browser-like client (real UA, JS execution) before any liveness verdict.

negative_findings.description: No confirmed public, structured, searchable case database was found for КЗК decisions — the site appears to be a WordPress publication with date/category archives rather than a queryable decision register.
negative_findings.result_summary: Competition decisions likely have to be harvested by crawling archives and filtering, not by querying a register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Raises collection cost and the risk of missing older bank-fee or card-scheme cases that predate the current site structure.

negative_findings.description: English-language searching in this cell (State Audit Office / appeals commission + banking contract) surfaced almost nothing beyond institutional descriptions; substantive oversight output is published only in Macedonian, with occasional Albanian.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only collection would miss essentially the entire evidentiary layer of this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that Macedonian-language processing (including Cyrillic-aware OCR for scanned PDFs) is a hard requirement, not an optimisation.

negative_findings.description: No established Macedonian term was identified for 'bid rigging' as a distinct competition-law offence in tenders; searches relied on 'картел', 'договорено дејствување' and 'усогласено однесување' by inference rather than from a confirmed official source.
negative_findings.result_summary: The bid-rigging vocabulary for MK competition enforcement remains unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword filters built on guessed terminology will silently under-recall КЗК cases that are exactly the ones most relevant to A2.

negative_findings.description: No civil-society or transparency-layer source was found that specifically tracks banking- or payments-sector procurement in North Macedonia. Targeted mk-language searching combining tender/contract terms with banking and IT/software terms ('истражувачко новинарство Македонија тендери банка договор', 'SCOOP Македонија Фокус Нова истражување тендер ИТ софтвер банка набавка') returned only generic ministry procurement pages, an investment story about a Bulgarian software firm, and unrelated media-funding polemics.
negative_findings.result_summary: The MK transparency/CSO layer is organised by institution and by corruption risk, not by economic sector. Banking and payments contracts must be extracted by filtering generic procurement datasets (CPV codes, buyer = NBRM and state-owned financial entities, supplier names), not by finding a sector-specific watchdog.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets expectations for the collection design: this cell yields horizontal datasets and analysis, and sector focus has to be imposed downstream by the collector, not sourced ready-made.

negative_findings.description: Broad mk-language queries using the natural local terms ('мониторинг на јавни набавки извештај НВО тендери Македонија', 'отворени податоци јавни набавки Македонија анализа договори') were dominated by ministry '/javni-nabavki' pages rather than by civil-society monitors. The CSO layer only surfaced once organisation names were used as query terms.
negative_findings.result_summary: Generic Macedonian procurement vocabulary is heavily polluted by the mandatory per-ministry procurement pages. Actor-name-anchored queries were required to reach the transparency layer.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Flags 'јавни набавки' as a noisy term for discovery and argues for an actor-first (name-anchored) discovery strategy in future MK passes for this cell.

negative_findings.description: IRL is described (in GIJN coverage and its own materials) as having built technical solutions for searching public databases more efficiently, but no publicly accessible procurement database or search tool operated by IRL was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: IRL's database tooling appears to be internal to the newsroom rather than a public asset; only its published stories were confirmed as accessible.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-crediting IRL as a data source. It should be tracked as a story/lead feed, and a direct approach would be needed to learn whether any tooling is shareable.

negative_findings.description: No established Macedonian-language equivalent of 'open contracting' / 'OCDS' was observed in any result. The mk-language framing is consistently 'јавните набавки како отворени податоци' (public procurement as open data), while OCDS/open-contracting terminology appears only in English-language sources (OCP registry, Opentender, OGP).
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language discovery for the standards layer must use the descriptive Macedonian phrasing; the technical vocabulary is English-only in this jurisdiction.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector searching mk for 'отворено договарање' or transliterated OCDS terms will find nothing; the productive mk phrase is 'отворени податоци' + 'јавни набавки' / 'склучени договори'.

negative_findings.description: Several high-value URLs in this slice were obtained from link inventories or third-party coverage rather than from a successful direct fetch in this pass: javninabavki.opendata.mk, www.aktivnatransparentnost.mk, open.finance.gov.mk, transparentnost-mk.org.mk (http-only), and the e-nabavki.gov.mk InstitutionGridData.aspx endpoint.
negative_findings.result_summary: These are recorded as candidates with reduced confidence and access_status 'unverified'. No claim is made about their liveness.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass should prioritise these five; a 403 or timeout on any of them should be read as bot-defence, not death.

negative_findings.description: Both the mk seed query ('банка Македонија потпиша договор нов систем плаќања') and its English equivalent returned payment-infrastructure programme news (MIPS/ISO 20022 modernisation, TIPS accession, Western Balkans interlinking) but no article naming a specific bank-vendor contract signature.
negative_findings.result_summary: Macedonian media report programme milestones and product launches; explicit 'X bank signed with vendor Y' stories are rare and must be inferred from launch coverage naming the technology partner.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must target launch/implementation vocabulary (лансира, имплементација, во соработка со, решение на) rather than contract vocabulary, or recall will be near zero.

negative_findings.description: ictactual.mk was probed as a possible MK ICT trade outlet; the search returned no article from that domain and the domain was not fetched.
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence gathered for ictactual.mk in this pass; it is neither confirmed live nor confirmed dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: It should be re-probed directly by the liveness pass rather than dropped, since a dedicated MK ICT trade outlet would be high-value for vendor-side signals.

negative_findings.description: Kapital's web domain (kapital.mk) was inferred from the publication's known brand and its Wikipedia entry; no kapital.mk URL appeared in search results and no fetch was attempted.
negative_findings.result_summary: Kapital is confirmed to exist as an economy/business weekly; its live web presence is unconfirmed here.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated-URL error and flags the item for deterministic verification.

negative_findings.description: This pass relied on search-engine result surfacing; individual outlet pages were not fetched, so no liveness, robots.txt, RSS-availability or paywall state was directly observed for any candidate.
negative_findings.result_summary: All access_status and blocked values are hypotheses from search metadata and publicly known outlet behaviour.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream verification must not treat these fields as confirmed; a 403/timeout on any of them would indicate bot defence, not death.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated North Macedonian banking-IT conference with a public sponsor/exhibitor page was found. Sponsor and exhibitor rosters for MK banking/payments events (EACHA Skopje 2026, MicroBalkans 2026, MASIT annual conference) appear only in prose news coverage or generic thank-you statements, not as structured, crawlable sponsor pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in mk for 'конференција банкарство плаќања Македонија програма спонзори' and 'MASIT ... спонзори изложувачи' returned event coverage but no structured sponsor/exhibitor listings.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sponsorship tiers are the cleanest quantitative pre-tender signal in this cell; without structured pages the collection method must be manual capture of event sites during the weeks around each edition, which needs a calendar-driven routine rather than a crawler.

negative_findings.description: No public pre-tender RFI/RFP or 'market consultation' channel operated by MK commercial banks was found. MK commercial banks are private entities not covered by the public-procurement regime, so RFIs are issued privately to vendor shortlists.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches combining bank names with implementation/tender terms returned only job ads, vendor PR and award news - no bank-hosted supplier/tender portal surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the premise of this cell: for commercial banks, hiring, conference and sponsorship signals are not merely earlier than formal notices, they may be the only public signal at all. Only state-linked entities (NBRM, Развојна банка/МБДП) are likely to leave formal traces.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn job postings and people-movement data for MK banks could not be retrieved via search; only company profile pages were returned.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search for MK bank core-banking/payments roles on LinkedIn returned company pages and Wikipedia entries, no live postings.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: LinkedIn is likely the single richest hiring-signal source for named platforms (Temenos, ISO 20022, Oracle FLEXCUBE etc.), but it is login-walled and its ToS forbids scraping - it must be staffed as a manual analyst routine, not automated, or the cell will systematically under-collect.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched directly; all were observed in search results only. In particular the MIA.mk article URL is heavily percent-encoded and may need re-resolution, and the e-Работа search page is an ASPX form whose result pages may not be directly addressable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Discovery was search-driven; a separate deterministic verification pass is required.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confidence scores here reflect the strength of the evidence that the source exists and is relevant, not that any specific URL resolves today.

negative_findings.description: No established Macedonian-language term was found for the pre-tender concepts 'RFI' or 'market consultation' in a commercial-bank context; MK-language results used only 'оглас'/'јавен повик' (public-sector framing) or the English acronyms. Likewise no MK term for 'vendor shortlist' surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: mk queries around барање за понуда / јавен повик in a bank context produced public-procurement and job-ad results, not bank pre-tender material.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Glossary gap constrains local-language recall; future runs should test 'барање за прибирање понуди', 'повик за доставување понуди', 'тендерска документација' against bank domains specifically.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Macedonian for tender/procurement pages on the MK subsidiary domains of the foreign parents in scope (nlb.mk, halkbank.mk, sparkasse.mk) using Cyrillic procurement vocabulary.
negative_findings.result_summary: No procurement, tender or supplier-notice section surfaced for any of the three MK bank sites. Results were dominated by recruitment notices ('оглас за вработување') and retail product pages — a strong reminder that in MK 'оглас' is a heavily polluted term meaning both tender notice and job advert.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: MK commercial-bank procurement appears to be largely invisible on the banks' own MK web estate, which pushes the whole cell's weight onto parent-side publication, regional aggregators and archives. It also means 'оглас' must always be paired with 'набавка'/'тендер' to be usable as a query term.

negative_findings.description: The cell brief names Şekerbank as a parent group. Attempted to confirm a Şekerbank (TR) ownership link to TTK Banka AD Skopje.
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence of a Şekerbank–TTK Banka ownership relationship was found. Available profiles instead describe TTK Banka as formed in 2006 from the merger of Teteks Kreditna Banka and Tetovska Banka, with Teteks Group (~44%) and EBRD (25%, acquired October 2006) as major shareholders. This may be stale data and does not disprove a later transaction.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If the Şekerbank link is wrong or historical, tracking Turkish parent-side procurement for TTK would waste collection budget; conversely, an unrecorded EBRD stake makes ECEPP a more important channel than assumed. The ownership chain must be pinned from MSE/NBRM filings before the parent-side watchlist is finalised.

negative_findings.description: Fetched the Erste Group Procurement page to locate a published tender or RFP feed for group suppliers.
negative_findings.result_summary: The page exposes supplier documents (NDA, audit questionnaire, scorecards, Supplier Code of Conduct) and describes centralised supply management, but publishes no tender notices and does not enumerate which subsidiaries or countries it serves.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that group-level buying at the Sparkasse/Erste side is a closed, invitation-based process. No notice-scraping strategy will work there; intelligence must come from supplier-side disclosures, code-of-conduct localisations, and vendor case studies instead.

negative_findings.description: Attempted to confirm nabavke.com's advertised Macedonian coverage and access model by direct fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: The fetch returned only the page title; body content was not present in the server-rendered HTML, so country coverage, pricing and terms could not be established. Coverage claims (RS, ME, BA, MK, HR, SI) come from search-result snippets, not from the site itself.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Both leading regional aggregators are commercial and JS-heavy. Their real MK depth — and whether they retain expired notices, which is the whole point for this cell — is unknown and must be tested in a trial before any subscription spend.

negative_findings.description: Searched for evidence of a specific parent-group framework agreement (core banking, cards, payments) cascading to a North Macedonian subsidiary.
negative_findings.result_summary: No concrete framework-agreement document or award naming both a parent group and its MK subsidiary was located through open search in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's core hypothesis — that group framework contracts are decided abroad and cascade to MK — remains a plausible but unevidenced structural assumption. It should be tested against NLB/Erste annual reports and vendor press releases rather than assumed in downstream analysis.

negative_findings.description: Query-term reliability assessment for Macedonian search.
negative_findings.result_summary: 'оглас' collides with job adverts; 'НЛБ'/'NLB' collides strongly with the UK Northern Lighthouse Board and Kenya's National Lottery Board in English search; 'Halkbank' collides with a Turkmen bank, a Serbian bank of the same name and a volleyball club; 'набавка' alone returns overwhelmingly public-sector (government) results rather than commercial-bank buying.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any automated query fleet built for this cell needs disambiguating co-terms ('NLB Skupina', 'Халкбанк АД Скопје', 'јавна набавка' + 'банка') or it will drown in false positives.

negative_findings.description: Every direct fetch attempt against nbrm.mk (root, /javni-nabavki.nspx) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: The domain is clearly live and richly indexed by search engines, so this is bot protection / user-agent filtering, not a dead site. All nbrm.mk candidates are recorded as unverified-but-presumed-live and flagged blocked=true.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important publisher in this cell cannot be collected with a naive HTTP client; the pipeline needs a headless browser or realistic-header fetcher, otherwise the cell will silently produce zero coverage.

negative_findings.description: The bare term 'Народна банка' is highly ambiguous across Slavic-language search space.
negative_findings.result_summary: A Macedonian query combining 'Народна банка' with banknote/coin procurement terms returned almost exclusively Bulgarian National Bank (БНБ, bnb.bg) pages and no Macedonian results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Queries and any future keyword monitors must disambiguate with 'РСМ', 'Северна Македонија', 'НБРСМ', or a site: restriction, or the collector will be flooded with Bulgarian and Serbian central-bank content.

negative_findings.description: The exact URL of the NBRNM statutory Register of Payment Institutions was not located.
negative_findings.result_summary: The register's existence and legal basis are confirmed from the consolidated Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems text hosted on nbrm.mk, but the 403 responses prevented navigating the site menu to the register page itself.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This register is the definitive licensed-actor map for the payments half of the cell; leaving its URL unresolved leaves a hole in licensing coverage.

negative_findings.description: No stable, entity-filtered public URL for 'National Bank' notices on e-nabavki.gov.mk was identified from search alone.
negative_findings.result_summary: The ESJN platform is confirmed as the publication venue and grid/service endpoints were observed (InstitutionGridData.aspx, /services/*.asmx), but the exact query parameters or POST payload needed to filter to the National Bank as договорен орган were not established without interactive browsing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without a deterministic filtered query the collector must crawl broadly and post-filter, which is far more expensive and more likely to be rate-limited.

negative_findings.description: No 2025 or 2026 NBRNM tender notice was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: The most concrete NBRNM procurement evidence found was a coins supply notice published 05/03/2024 (deadline 29/03/2024, CPV 18512100, 2 lots) surfaced via the EU Publications Office, plus a general reference to construction works for the bank's building.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Recency of NBRNM tender flow is unestablished; the collector should baseline the last 3-5 years from ESJN/TED rather than assume current activity levels.

negative_findings.description: Targeted Macedonian-language searching for KIBS procurement ('КИБС Клириншка куќа Скопје јавна набавка') returned no tender or procurement page. A direct fetch of the KIBS news page showed only a 'ВЕСТИ И ПРОМОЦИИ' section with no procurement notices.
negative_findings.result_summary: KIBS appears to publish no public tender channel; as a joint-stock company owned by banks it is likely outside the Public Procurement Law's contracting-authority scope, so its buying is invisible in ЕСЈН.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payments-rail demand at the clearing house must be inferred indirectly (news, vendor press releases, NBRM oversight reports, shareholder-bank disclosures) rather than tracked from tender feeds.

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language search 'Централен депозитар за хартии од вредност тендер ИТ систем' surfaced only corporate/organisational pages, an MSE issuer profile and NBRM's description of CDHV — no tender listing.
negative_findings.result_summary: No CDHV tender portal identified in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: CSD system-replacement opportunities will have to be picked up from MSE-published annual reports and shareholder-meeting materials, not from a procurement feed.

negative_findings.description: Search for NBRM's own procurement notices ('Народна банка ... јавни набавки МИПС платен систем оглас') did not return an NBRM javni-nabavki page; results were general MIPS/central-bank pages plus unrelated commercial bank PDFs.
negative_findings.result_summary: NBRM procurement page URL not confirmed. NBRM is expected to publish either on its own site or in ЕСЈН.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: NBRM operates MIPS (RTGS) and is a high-value buyer; missing its procurement channel would be a material blind spot.

negative_findings.description: The appeals commission appeared under three hostnames in results: dkzjn.gov.mk, dkzjn.mk, and a vendor-hosted dkzjn.sorsix.com. Similarly KIBS appeared as both kibs.mk and kibs.com.mk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Canonical hostnames unresolved; none of these were fetched, so none should be treated as dead or as duplicates without a verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collectors pointed at a non-canonical host risk silent data loss when it is retired.

negative_findings.description: The term 'куќа' in 'Клириншка куќа' is highly polysemous — the KIBS query returned an Airbnb guest-house listing. 'Депозитар' and 'набавка' are cleaner. 'Тендер' is used less than 'оглас'/'јавна набавка' in official MK sources.
negative_findings.result_summary: Glossary note: prefer 'јавна набавка', 'оглас', 'договор за јавна набавка', 'ЕСЈН' over 'тендер'; always pair 'Клириншка куќа' with 'КИБС'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query hygiene materially changes recall in the Macedonian corpus.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, standing publication channel was found for cash-in-transit / cash handling procurement by MK municipalities and utilities. Searches using 'пренос на пари', 'транспорт на готовина', 'обезбедување' returned only unrelated municipal material-transport tenders, УЈП procurement procedure documents, and the AML law.
negative_findings.result_summary: Cash-in-transit demand appears to be visible only as individual notices inside ЕСЈН, not via any topical aggregator or supplier-side register I could locate.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: CIT is a core Printec-adjacent service line; if it is only discoverable via keyword filtering inside ЕСЈН, the collection design must rely on a well-tuned MK keyword/CPV filter rather than on any dedicated feed.

negative_findings.description: No public tender notice or procurement page was found for the ЈСП Скопје 'Скопска' electronic ticketing / mobile payment system, despite abundant media coverage of the scheme itself. ЈСП does not appear to maintain a public procurement listing of its own that search engines surface.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only media and operator pages (radiomof, skopjeinfo, fakulteti, a1.mk) describe the scheme; the underlying contracts were not locatable from the open web in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Fare collection is one of the highest-volume municipal payment estates in MK; if its contracts are only reachable via ЕСЈН authority-level search or FOI, that must be an explicit collection step rather than an assumption.

negative_findings.description: WebFetch of the ЕСЈН open-data contracts page returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with no body.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as bot-defence, not as a dead source; the page is referenced from multiple government pages and is presumed live but unverified by me.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The open-data layer is the highest-value structured source in this cell; the collection design must budget for a browser-context or authenticated fetch path rather than a plain HTTP client.

negative_findings.description: The State Commission for Appeals in Public Procurement appears under at least three hosts in search results: dkzjn.gov.mk, dkzjn.mk, and dkzjn.sorsix.com.
negative_findings.result_summary: I did not determine which is canonical or whether the others are legacy/mirror/vendor instances.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pointing a scheduled collector at a legacy host risks silently stale appeals data on a high-value source.

negative_findings.description: No MK-specific commercial tender-aggregation service was confirmed for this cell. One result (gtbc.net 'North Macedonia tender notices 2026 by sector') suggests such aggregators exist, but I did not verify its coverage, sourcing or terms.
negative_findings.result_summary: Commercial aggregator landscape unmapped; not recorded as a candidate because I could not substantiate it.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A licensed aggregator could remove the need to scrape ЕСЈН, but only if its coverage of municipal/ЈП buyers is genuine rather than a reseller of the same portal.

negative_findings.description: UN Development Business (devbusiness.un.org), historically the mandatory publication venue for World Bank General Procurement Notices, phased down and ceased activity on its website on 31 March 2025.
negative_findings.result_summary: Legacy GPN pages still resolve, but the platform is no longer a live feed; WB procurement plans that cite 'publication in UNDB' now effectively route through STEP and the WB external site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collector built on UNDB would silently go stale; the GPN channel for MK WB projects must be re-pointed to the World Bank projects/procurement pages.

negative_findings.description: No specific TED notice for a North Macedonia banking or payment-system procurement was surfaced through general web search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned TED platform/meta pages and unrelated MK notices (insurance, events, road transport) rather than a payments-sector notice.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that TED must be queried through its own expert search/API with country and CPV filters rather than via general web search; absence here is a search-method limitation, not evidence that no such notices exist.

negative_findings.description: No IFC-specific procurement or advisory-tender channel for North Macedonia financial sector was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: IFC did not appear in any of the donor-procurement searches run; IFC advisory engagements are typically not tendered publicly in the way IBRD/EBRD project procurement is.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: IFC was named in the cell scope; its low public-procurement footprint should be recorded so the cell is not treated as incomplete, but IFC disclosure portals still need a dedicated pass.

negative_findings.description: No Macedonian-language donor procurement portal exists for EBRD, World Bank, UNDP or KfW notices — all publish in English only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Macedonian-language searching productively found the national/IPA side (CFCD, СЕП, МЕП, Министерство за финансии) but returned no MK-language IFI notice source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The MK-language layer of this cell is inherently limited to the national IPA structures; collectors must not expect MK text from the IFI side, and analysts should not read the absence of MK notices as absence of activity.

negative_findings.description: DevelopmentAid tender records for MK donor tenders are gated behind a paid membership.
negative_findings.result_summary: Tender view pages render title, donor, sector and status but withhold the notice body and documents without a subscription.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Useful as a discovery index only; evidence-grade collection must go back to the originating donor portal.

negative_findings.description: ECEPP, UNGM and e-nabavki.gov.mk were identified from search results and documentation rather than fetched; their crawlability is a hypothesis.
negative_findings.result_summary: All three are known to be JS-heavy and/or registration-gated; no fetch was attempted in this pass, so no liveness or blocking claim is made.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design for these three should budget for headless browsing or account-based alerting; a later verification pass must confirm.

negative_findings.description: Direct navigation inventory of kb.mk (Комерцијална банка) returned no section for набавки, тендери, огласи за прибирање понуди or supplier registration. Only IR, financial reports, news and media contact exist.
negative_findings.result_summary: No supplier/tender page found on the largest MK bank's website.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale: for the biggest buyer in the market there is zero direct procurement disclosure, so collection must fall back to financial statements and press.

negative_findings.description: Navigation inventory of stb.com.mk (Стопанска банка) likewise showed no procurement, tender or supplier section; the closest items are 'Податоци и извештаи' and 'Новости'.
negative_findings.result_summary: No tender/RFP page on Stopanska Banka.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Second systemic bank with no direct channel; reinforces that A2 coverage for MK private banks cannot be built on bank-published tenders.

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language queries using the exact domestic procurement vocabulary (оглас за прибирање понуди, јавен повик за понудувачи, набавка, тендер) combined with bank names returned only (a) recruitment ads, (b) foreclosed-property sale ads, and (c) generic public-procurement law material — never a bank buying-side call.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language procurement terms are used by MK banks almost exclusively for HIRING and for SELLING repossessed assets, not for buying.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is a terminology trap: naive keyword collection on 'оглас'/'повик' against bank domains will produce a corpus that is ~all noise. Filters must exclude вработување and продажба на преземен/недвижен имот.

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language (sq) procurement pages for MK banks were pursued in this pass, although Albanian is widely used by parts of the MK banking customer base (notably Halkbank and TTK).
negative_findings.result_summary: sq coverage not attempted; run scope specified mk+en only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A small residual risk that an sq-language 'thirrje për oferta' notice exists and was missed.

negative_findings.description: Silk Road Banka (Силк Роуд банка АД Скопје) did not surface with any usable procurement or annual-report URL in the local-language sweep; only aggregate mentions appeared.
negative_findings.result_summary: No confirmed URL captured for Silk Road Banka in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: One named actor in the cell remains uncovered; must be closed in a follow-up pass rather than assumed absent.

negative_findings.description: No vendor press release announcing a core-banking system contract or migration with a named North Macedonian bank was found in this pass, in either English or Macedonian.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on core-banking vendors plus MK returned only generic vendor marketing and comparison pages; no MK-named award, go-live or signing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Core-banking replacements are the largest single IT spend at a bank; if vendors do not announce them for MK, the cell must rely on bank annual reports, regulator filings and hiring signals instead of vendor evidence.

negative_findings.description: No Diebold Nixdorf or NCR Atleos announcement naming an MK bank or MK ATM contract was surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only global/company-strategy coverage returned; ATM hardware OEM presence in MK appears to be mediated by integrators (Printec, ASEE/Payten) rather than announced directly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Implies the correct monitoring target for ATM fleet renewal in MK is the integrator/reseller layer, not the OEM newsroom.

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language search for vendor/contract phrasing ('добавувач', 'договор', 'информатички систем', 'картично работење') returned almost exclusively regulator and bank product pages, not vendor announcements.
negative_findings.result_summary: MK-language vendor press releases appear scarce or not well indexed; the local-language signal concentrates in trade press (bankarstvo.mk) and social posts instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language collection for this cell should be aimed at trade press and vendor LinkedIn/Facebook, not at vendor corporate websites, which are largely English.

negative_findings.description: No Payten item specific to North Macedonia was found despite an active, granular regional news feed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payten publishes bank-named POS/ATM deliveries for Albania and Serbia but nothing MK-specific surfaced in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Absence is itself a signal about where ASEE/Payten concentrates public reference-building; MK evidence may sit in Albanian/Serbian-language or group-level reporting instead.

negative_findings.description: kibs.mk, duna.com.mk and sorsix.com were inferred from company identity rather than reached in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Entities are well attested (KIBS via Nextsense/NBRM references; Duna and Sorsix via MK directories and social profiles) but their canonical domains were not confirmed here.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These should be treated as unverified URLs for the deterministic liveness pass, not as dead or fabricated.

negative_findings.description: No MK security-printing or cash-in-transit (CIT) supplier was identified despite a dedicated Macedonian-language search ('заштитно печатење чекови картички', 'обезбедување транспорт на пари').
negative_findings.result_summary: Results returned only banking law, NBRM check regulation and generic payment-security pages — no named banknote/cheque printer or CIT/cash-handling company serving MK banks.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cash-handling and security-printing suppliers are an explicit part of this cell; without them the supplier map is incomplete on the physical-cash side.

negative_findings.description: Searching for POS/ATM distributors and maintenance firms in Macedonian returned only bank product pages, not supplier pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query 'дистрибутер POS терминали Македонија банкомати одржување компанија Скопје' surfaced kb.com.mk, stb.com.mk, ohridskabanka.mk tariff pages instead of vendors; bank-side pages dominate the term space.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: 'ПОС терминал' and 'банкомат' are noisy terms owned by bank marketing pages; supplier discovery needs company-name-first queries or procurement/job-ad proxies instead.

negative_findings.description: No Macedonia-specific country page for Printec or a local Payten/ASEE MK entity site was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Printec search resolved to the Bulgaria country page plus an expired MK job ad; Payten MK query returned mostly Bulgarian results and unrelated PayNet terminals.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two of the most likely bank-equipment suppliers in MK lack a confirmed local URL, so their MK activity must currently be inferred from job ads and group-level releases.

negative_findings.description: Duna Computers' own corporate domain was not confirmed; only Facebook, ZoomInfo and a SeeNews interview were found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned social and third-party profiles rather than a first-party site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: First-party reference pages are the highest-value artefact for 'we delivered' claims; this one is missing from the collection plan.

negative_findings.description: No tender/RFP publication channel of any kind was found for private North Macedonian payments actors (CaSys, KIBS, Monri, Paysera MK, Flex Pay, IutePay). Neither mk nor en queries combining actor names with набавка/тендер/оглас/RFP surfaced a supplier or procurement page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Private PSPs/processors in MK appear not to publish tenders at all; their buying is visible only after the fact through press, partnership announcements and scheme certifications.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For this cell, workstream A2 cannot rely on tender-notice harvesting; it must be re-based on award-shaped news, licensing events and register diffs as procurement proxies.

negative_findings.description: nbrm.mk returned HTTP 403 to a plain fetch of the payment-institutions hub page, while the same pages are indexed and linked from multiple sources.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as bot defence on a live site, not as a dead source; not verified either way in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important register in this cell needs a browser-grade fetcher; a naive HTTP collector would silently record the country's core registers as unavailable.

negative_findings.description: The licensed PI/EMI population could not be enumerated in full from search results alone. Only Paysera Macedonia and Flex Pay were confirmed as e-money licensees by press, with IutePay Macedonia mentioned as offering payment accounts/wallet services; the authoritative register content was not read because of the 403.
negative_findings.result_summary: Actor list for the cell is partial and press-derived rather than register-derived.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Every downstream demand estimate for this cell depends on the true count of licensed non-bank PSPs; a press-derived list will undercount.

negative_findings.description: No established Macedonian-language term was found in use for 'bill-pay network' or 'payment kiosk operator' as a distinct licensed category; searches on плаќање сметки / киоск returned only bank Western Union pages and no standalone operator.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bill-pay/kiosk aggregation appears not to exist as a separately named, separately licensed segment in MK, or is absorbed into bank and post-office channels.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A whole sub-segment of the cell brief (bill-pay networks) may be structurally absent in MK rather than merely undiscovered — this needs to be settled before it is scored as a gap in coverage.

negative_findings.description: No North Macedonia country page or local-entity presence was located in this pass for the card schemes themselves (Visa, Mastercard, Diners Club) as procuring entities; scheme activity in MK is visible only through their certified processors and member banks.
negative_findings.result_summary: Schemes are present in MK indirectly, via CaSys certification and bank membership, not via a local buying entity.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means scheme-driven demand must be tracked through mandates and certification requirements imposed on local processors, not through any scheme-side procurement channel.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed, robust technical access route into the ESJN notice/award records — the root 403s to a plain client and the open-data endpoint is unlocated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Next pass: drive https://e-nabavki.gov.mk/PublicAccess/Home.aspx with a headless browser, capture the XHR/postback calls behind the notice and contract grids, and hunt the 'Отворени податоци' link inside the UI. Document the resulting endpoints and paging parameters.

coverage_gaps.description: The ESJN record schema (fields per notice, CPV usage, whether lot-level values and bidder names are published in award notices) was not observed first-hand.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Read the BJN ESJN user manual PDF end-to-end and pull two or three sample dossiers to define the extraction schema before building the collector.

coverage_gaps.description: Small-value purchases routed through the e-Пазар marketplace may never appear in the public notice grids, hiding a long tail of POS/terminal/receipt-media purchases.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Determine from the e-Пазар manuals and the PublicAccess grids whether e-Пазар outcomes are publicly published; if not, escalate to an FOI request via the ASPI holders register or accept and document the blindspot.

coverage_gaps.description: No enumerated list of payments-relevant contracting authorities (state-owned banks and financial institutions, Фонд за здравствено осигурување, Фонд за ПИОМ, Управа за јавни приходи, Царинска управа, public enterprises, 80+ municipalities) was compiled.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest the institution list from ESJN InstitutionGridData and from vlada.mk, then score each authority for payments relevance to prioritise monitoring.

coverage_gaps.description: Annual procurement plans (годишни планови за јавни набавки), which flag intended purchases months ahead of a notice, were identified as a source pattern but not systematically located per authority.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated sweep for 'годишен план за јавни набавки' PDFs on both ESJN and institutional sites each January-March.

coverage_gaps.description: Службен весник на РСМ (Official Gazette) was not examined as a channel for procurement-related legal changes and thresholds.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check whether amendments to Законот за јавните набавки and its подзаконски акти are best tracked via slvesnik.com.mk or via the BJN /propisi/ section, and pick one as canonical.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian is an official language in North Macedonia and some notices and institutional pages may be published in Albanian; this pass searched only in Macedonian and English.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Albanian-language terms (prokurimi publik, njoftim kontrate, tender) to the next discovery pass and check whether ESJN offers an Albanian interface.

coverage_gaps.description: ESJN (e-nabavki.gov.mk) is an ASP.NET application whose public grids were not exercised in this pass; the parameterised queries needed to filter by contracting authority and CPV for financial services are unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated technical probe of e-nabavki.gov.mk grids/web services to define a repeatable query for the six cell authorities and financial-service CPV codes.

coverage_gaps.description: Only central-state buyers were covered; state-owned enterprises and agencies that also buy payment/banking services (e.g. Agency for Financial Support in Agriculture, Employment Agency, Health Insurance regional offices, public utilities) were out of scope here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the actor map from the BJN/uslugi.gov.mk registries to secondary budget users and SOEs in a follow-up cell.

coverage_gaps.description: No Albanian-language (sq) searching was performed, although MK institutions publish bilingually in many cases.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add sq-language queries (prokurime publike, njoftim për kontratë) for the same authorities.

coverage_gaps.description: Archive hosts (arhiva.finance.gov.mk, old.customs.gov.mk, arhiva-cfcd.finance.gov.mk) were identified but not enumerated, so time depth of available award history is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot-crawl the archive hosts once and record earliest available year per authority.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was confirmed live; two key hosts failed to fetch from this environment.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route all candidates through the deterministic liveness pass with a MK-locale headless client before scoring access status.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank payment institutions and e-money institutions licensed under the new MK payment services law are not covered by any association member list found; their register presumably sits on the bot-defended NBRSM site and was not retrieved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch NBRSM supervision/registers pages with a headless browser and extract the payment-institution and e-money registers as a distinct actor class.

coverage_gaps.description: Whether ESJN exposes a stable public API or only ASP.NET .asmx/grid endpoints was not established; the observed endpoints suggest scrapable JSON services but this is unverified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe e-nabavki.gov.mk service endpoints and check data.gov.mk for an official procurement dataset/API before building a scraper.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language mirrors were only confirmed for MASIT (members-en) and partially for CCC; most registers in this cell are Macedonian-only, and Albanian-language variants were not searched at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Albanian (sq) query terms for procurement/registry concepts, since MK institutions publish some content in Albanian.

coverage_gaps.description: Only the national chamber (mchamber.mk) and MASIT were mapped; other MK chambers (e.g. Стопанска комора на Македонија/Economic Chamber of North-West Macedonia, foreign investors' councils) were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate all chambers via the biznisregulativa.mk /Komoris/ index and harvest each member directory.

coverage_gaps.description: No source for supplier financial statements (annual accounts) was identified beyond the Central Registry's paid channel, limiting ability to size vendors discovered through award data.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate Central Registry distribution-service pricing and any commercial MK company-data aggregators as a licensed alternative.

coverage_gaps.description: The ДКЖЈН decision register itself was never actually opened — the institutional homepage did not render to a plain fetch and the possible application instance (dkzjn.sorsix.com) was not inspected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a headless-browser reconnaissance pass over dkzjn.gov.mk and dkzjn.sorsix.com to map the decision-listing route, pagination, filter parameters and any XHR/JSON endpoint before designing the crawler.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language coverage was not attempted, although ДЗР brands itself bilingually (Enti Shtetëror i Revizionit) and Albanian-language versions of oversight documents and media coverage likely exist.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an Albanian query pass: 'Enti Shtetëror i Revizionit raport', 'Komisioni Shtetëror për Ankesa për Prokurime Publike vendim', 'Komisioni për Mbrojtjen e Konkurrencës'.

coverage_gaps.description: Several plausible oversight actors in this cell were not searched: Државен правобранител (State Attorney, represents the state in procurement disputes), Финансиска полиција / Управа за финансиска полиција, Инспекторат / внатрешна ревизија within the Ministry of Finance, and the Комисија за заштита на правото на слободен пристап appeal decisions as a distinct decision series.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated actor-expansion pass on these bodies with local-language names before concluding the actor map is complete.

coverage_gaps.description: Supranational oversight layers were not covered: European Commission enlargement / rule-of-law country reports and SIGMA-OECD public procurement assessments both audit the MK appeals and audit system and quantify its weaknesses.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add EC annual North Macedonia Report (chapter on public procurement) and SIGMA monitoring reports as pointer sources; they also name the systemic gaps that explain why certain contracts never reach appeal.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival strategy was identified. Both dkzjn.gov.mk and kzk.gov.mk have visibly restructured over time (legacy 'old.' subdomains, http-only archive years), so older banking-related decisions may only survive in web archives.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query the Wayback Machine CDX API for historical snapshots of dkzjn.gov.mk, kzk.gov.mk and dzr.mk decision/report listings to recover URLs that no longer resolve.

coverage_gaps.description: The join between an ESJN award notice and its ДКЖЈН appeal case number was assumed rather than verified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Verify on a live example whether ESJN exposes an appeal/complaint status field on public notice pages, and whether ДКЖЈН decisions cite the ESJN procedure number — this determines whether the oversight trail can be automatically stitched to the tender.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language (sq) civil-society and media coverage of MK procurement was entirely out of scope for this run (languages were set to mk and en) and therefore uncovered. Albanian-language outlets and CSOs are a substantial part of the North Macedonian public sphere and monitor procurement in Albanian-majority municipalities.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an sq-language pass using terms such as 'prokurimi publik', 'tenderë', 'kontrata publike', 'monitorimi i prokurimit publik' targeted at MK-based Albanian-language outlets and CSOs.
coverage_gaps.coverage_dimension: language coverage of the civil-society layer

coverage_gaps.description: No commercial tender-aggregation or bid-alerting service for North Macedonia was properly assessed. One such vendor surfaced incidentally (selltostate.com listing an e-Nabavki agency feed) alongside generic 'Balkan tenders' listing sites, but their coverage, freshness and licensing were not evaluated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on commercial MK/Balkan tender-alert vendors; assess coverage depth, historical archive, export/API availability and terms of service before assuming they are usable.

coverage_gaps.description: Beyond CGK, the depth of the MK procurement-monitoring CSO field is unmapped. Umbrella and directory pointers were found (antikorupcija.mk members page, Civica Mobilitas grantee directory) but their member lists were not enumerated, so smaller and local watchdogs remain unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest the antikorupcija.mk members list and the Civica Mobilitas transparency/anti-corruption grantee listings, then run per-organisation checks for procurement outputs.

coverage_gaps.description: The actual coverage and freshness of the third-party structured datasets (Opentender MK, opendata.mk databases) relative to the official e-nabavki record was not measured. TED-derived data covers only above-threshold contracts, and MK is not an EU member, so the national-portal-derived share and its lag are decisive but unquantified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Download the Opentender/OCP MK dataset and reconcile record counts and latest-award dates against a sample pulled from the official concluded-contracts export; document the lag and the value-threshold cut-off.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival/mirror strategy was identified for the CSO layer. NGO sites and donor-project sites (balkantenderwatch.eu in particular, a project site dating from 2012) are prone to link rot and hosting lapses once funding cycles end.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Mirror key CGK, Balkan Tender Watch and OSF policy PDFs at collection time and record Wayback Machine snapshots for each candidate URL in this slice.
